title: Don't Lose the Future: Latent-Aware 4-Bit Quantization of World Action Models
title_zh: 别丢掉未来：世界动作模型的潜变量感知 4 位量化
abstract_en: World action models (WAMs) predict how a scene will evolve and condition their actions on this predicted future. Deploying them on a robot's onboard computer calls for 4-bit weights, activations and key-value caches (W4A4KV4). Existing 4-bit quantizers for WAMs preserve the generated action, and estimate sensitivity one denoising step at a time. However, they fail to preserve the fidelity of the predicted future: once the action pathway is protected, the remaining action error enters mostly through a degraded future that none of them deliberately protects. We propose LAQ, a latent-aware quantization framework that preserves the predicted future where it is written, stored and read. Specifically, we introduce a reader metric, which measures future error by its effect on the action, and a read count, which weights each rounding error by the number of denoising steps that read it. Together they give the allocation of precision over activations and caches a closed-form solution. We further develop gaze-guided refinement, which gives the tokens the action attends to a second 4-bit pass in the denoising loop and in the cache. All weights stay at 4 bits, with no high-precision branch and no per-task recalibration. On the LIBERO-Plus benchmark, LAQ reaches 76.4% and 83.3% average success on Fast-WAM and Cosmos-Policy, within 1.2 percentage points of the 16-bit models and all above the baselines with 16-bit KV caches. It compresses the model by 3.8x, reduces the peak GPU memory of the whole policy by 2.3x, and runs 1.66x faster than the 16-bit model. On a real AgileX PiPER arm, it reaches 47.0% average success over three tasks, against 52.0% for the 16-bit model and 30.0% higher than QuaRot.
abstract_zh: 世界动作模型（WAMs）先预测场景如何演变，再依据预测的未来生成动作。要在机器人板载计算机上部署这类模型，需要将权重、激活和键值缓存均量化为 4 位（W4A4KV4）。现有方法主要保护动作生成路径，并逐个去噪步估计量化敏感度，却未显式保护预测的未来。论文发现，保护动作路径后，剩余动作误差主要来自未来预测失真。为此，作者提出潜变量感知量化框架 LAQ，在未来表征的写入、存储和读取环节保护其保真度。LAQ 用读取度量（reader metric）衡量未来预测误差对动作的影响，用读取次数（read count）按读取该舍入误差的去噪步数加权，从而得到激活与缓存精度分配的闭式解。注视引导细化（gaze-guided refinement）还会在去噪循环和缓存中，对动作所关注的 token 额外执行一次 4 位处理。所有权重保持 4 位，无需高精度分支或逐任务重新校准。在 LIBERO-Plus 上，Fast-WAM 和 Cosmos-Policy 的平均成功率分别为 76.4% 和 83.3%，与对应 16 位模型的差距均不超过 1.2 个百分点，并超过采用 16 位 KV 缓存的基线。相比 16 位模型，LAQ 将模型大小和整套策略的峰值 GPU 显存分别降至约 1/3.8 和 1/2.3，运行速度达到 1.66 倍。在 AgileX PiPER 机械臂的三项实机任务中，LAQ 平均成功率为 47.0%，16 位模型为 52.0%；论文报告 LAQ 比 QuaRot 高 30.0%。
key_points_zh: 误差归因：保护动作路径后，剩余动作误差主要来自未来预测失真，而非动作路径本身。
精度分配：同时考虑未来预测误差对动作的影响，以及舍入误差在多个去噪步中被读取的次数，为激活和 KV 缓存推导出闭式分配方案。
关键 token 细化：在去噪循环和缓存中，为动作所关注的 token 增加一次 4 位处理，不引入高精度分支，也不需要逐任务重新校准。
部署表现：LIBERO-Plus 上两个模型与各自 16 位版本的成功率差距均不超过 1.2 个百分点；运行速度达到 1.66 倍，实机三任务平均成功率为 47.0%。
